determinate_findings: Overlapping attacks by different line leaders may create separate anchors when each independently satisfies the attack definition.
BANTE_FOLLOW eligibility is evaluated from the direct expected follower immediately before each attack, not from earlier line membership.
A rider who is solo immediately before attack has no BANTE_FOLLOW opportunity.
Visible incumbent defense during a sustained challenge is sufficient for INITIATIVE_CONFLICT PRESENT even when exact incumbent identity changes.
A clear take of an occupied position without sustained contest is INITIATIVE_CONFLICT ABSENT.
Insufficient visibility of the contest window yields INITIATIVE_CONFLICT UNKNOWN rather than ABSENT.
Follower reconnection does not count PRESENT if a rival again occupies the direct following position for the remainder of the observable six-second window.
A second acceleration inside one uninterrupted sustained attack is not a second anchor.

gaps.problem: The protocol defines a qualifying sustained forward move and its first timestamp but does not define when a completed attack episode has reset enough for the same rider to generate a later independent attack anchor.

The protocol excludes attacks after the race has clearly transitioned to terminal sprint, but does not state the fail-closed treatment when the available observation cannot establish whether that transition has already occurred.

next_gate: Proceed to T3 only with determinate semantics. Carry the two gaps as explicit unresolved research questions; do not tune answers from desired synthetic behavior.
